scripts.dev: bun run --parallel dev:api dev:mcp dev:app dev:docs dev:landing
scripts.build: bun run build:app && bun run build:docs && bun run build:landing
scripts.lint: bun --cwd apps/app lint && bun --cwd apps/docs lint && bun --cwd apps/landing lint
scripts.types:check: bun --cwd apps/app types:check && bun --cwd apps/docs types:check && bun --cwd apps/landing types:check
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo check --workspace --all-targets && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.check: bun run test:web && bun run lint && bun run types:check && bun run build && bun run check:rust
